title: BWS: 20% Cashback (Capped at $20 Per Order) @ Shopback
body:
Deal: BWS: 20% Cashback (Capped at $20 Per Order) @ Shopback

[King Steuart] The single malts on clearance at stores in a 25km radius of me have been raided hard the past few months, nothing new lol
I got a Glenmorangie, down to $74 rn so under $60 after cb
[try2bhelpful] I was doing a good trade in Muscat for a while. Not much left either.
[Ohreally] Yes correct - same here :( but everyone deserves a bargain so happy for the fellow alcoholic
[Pushka] Bought this new one on weekend, Peach Bellini 8%… loved it. Now got a case of 24 (4x6) now it is on special and with cashback works out to be ~$70/24pk
https://bws.com.au/product/6079337/
[M00Cow] Looks like an extra 5% on Westpac, St George, etc
[jmc787] Question - if I used Paypal which is linked to the Westpac credit card, do you get the bank bonus ?
[M00Cow] Unfortunately not. That gets seen as "PayPal…." not "BWS…"
[bin555] Is it one transaction or you can do two transactions?
[MonkDog] Can do two. Which is what I did to maximise my cashback.
